newsitem.title: INDONESIA: Indonesia palm olein weaker in late trading.
newsitem.headline: Indonesia palm olein weaker in late trading.

text.p: Indonesian palm olein prices were weaker in late trading on Thursday on thin buying interest amid falls in Malaysia, traders said.

They quoted palm olein at 1,440-50 rupiah/kg in Jakarta, compared with 1,445-50 rupiah/kg at the opening. Crude palm oil was done at 1,245 and 1,247 rupiah/kg at a tender for two parcels of 500 tonnes each in Medan on Wednesday.
"The market was very quiet following sharp falls in Malaysia," one trader said.
"Although Malaysian prices seemed to have recovered later later in the day, local buyers preferred to wait and see."
The trader said they expected prices to remain soft on Friday on the back of poor demand.
